elements.id-string-19: We study in this article   the blow-up of solutions to a coupled semilinear wave equations which are characterized by  linear damping terms in the \textit{scale-invariant regime}, time-derivative nonlinearities, mass terms and Tricomi terms.
elements.id-string-20: The latter are specifically of great interest from both physical and mathematical points of view since they allow the  speeds of propagation to be time-dependent ones.
elements.id-string-21: However, we assume in this work that both waves are propagating with the same speeds.
elements.id-string-22: Employing this fact together with other hypotheses on the aforementioned parameters (mass and damping coefficients), we obtain a new blow-up region for the system under consideration, and we show a lifespan estimate of the maximal existence time.
elements.id-string-24: We aim in this article to study the following system of two semilinear wave equations coupled via the time-derivative nonlinearities, and containing    scale-invariant damping terms,  mass terms and identical time-dependent speeds of propagation, namely
elements.id-string-25: \begin{equation} \begin{cases}\d u_{tt}-t^{2 \m}\Delta u +\frac{\mu_1}{t}u_t+\frac{\nu_1^2}{t^2}u=|\partial_t v|^p, &  x\in \mathbb{R}^N, \ t>1, \vspace{.1cm} \d v_{tt}-t^{2 \M}\Delta v +\frac{\mu_2}{t}v_t+\frac{\nu_2^2}{t^2}v=|\partial_t u|^q, &  x\in \R^N, \ t>1, u(x,1)=\e u_1(x), \ \ v(x,1)=\e v_1(x), & x\in \mathbb{R}^N,  u_t(x,1)=\e u_2(x), \ \  v_t(x,1)=\varepsilon v_2(x), & x\in \mathbb{R}^N, \end{cases} \end{equation}

elements.id-string-278: \title[Blow-up result for a weakly coupled system of wave  equations]{Blow-up result for a weakly coupled system oftwo Euler-Poisson-Darboux-Tricomi equations with time derivative nonlinearity}
elements.id-string-279: We study in this article   the blow-up of solutions to a coupled semilinear wave equations which are characterized by  linear damping terms in the \textit{scale-invariant regime}, time-derivative nonlinearities, mass  and Tricomi terms.
elements.id-string-280: The single equation corresponding to \eqref{G-sys} is studied in \cite{Lai-Palm-24, Pal24} where, to the best of our knowledge,  the name of {\it Euler-Poisson-Darboux-Tricomi} equation appeared for the first time.

elements.id-string-282: Concluding remarks and some open questions
elements.id-string-283: We derived in this article a blowing-up result related to a system composed of two coupled Euler-Poisson-Darboux-Tricomi equations with time derivative nonlinearity.
